Rules.heading: Categorisation rules
Rules.intro: Categories are assigned in layers: your manual assignments are always kept, and your own rules take precedence over standard rules. Case, umlauts and long digit sequences (card or transaction numbers) are ignored. If several rules match, the first one wins; more specific patterns such as “amazon prime” automatically come before general ones such as “amazon”. Changing the category of an imported transaction teaches a rule. Card categories from your bank (e.g. N26 “Mastercard • Groceries”) apply via an editable mapping – only after your rules and the standard rules.
Rules.autoIntro: Standard rules recognise common merchants and transaction types (e.g. REWE, Netflix, Deutsche Bahn, interest payments). Rules apply to every import; apply them here to existing transactions without a category. Automatically assigned categories are marked in the list.
